FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about choosing, financing and maintaining your system.

Speak to an Engineer →All FAQs
What products are available?

Hybrid and low frequency inverters, lithium ion batteries, solar panels, MPPT charge controllers, Sunbox solar home systems, AC/DC fans, freezers and cold storage, LED lighting and solar street lights. Ask the team to confirm current models and availability.

How do I know which solar system is right for me?

Start with what you need to power, how often you use it and how long you need backup power. We can assess your loads, usage patterns, existing power sources, available space and budget before recommending a system. You can also try the load calculator on our home page.

How do I ask for technical support?

Share the product details, system capacity and a brief description of the issue. This helps our technical team understand the problem and assist with troubleshooting.

What is Cloud Zero?

Cloud Zero is our range of complete rooftop solar packages. Each package combines a Cloud Energy inverter, batteries, a charge controller and solar panels, so a home or small business can run on solar power with little or no fuel spend.

Which battery types does Cloud Energy offer?

Our range includes LiFePO4 lithium ion batteries from 960Wh to 16.07kWh. Our low frequency inverters also work with AGM, gel and tubular batteries. The right option depends on your system design and storage needs.
